note: The image cards shown when a person first starts voice mode (a horizontal carousel: 4 visible on a phone, swipe for the rest). Picking a card picks the coach's face, name and voice; the coaching style is separate (the in-chat Navigator). label and preview are the V2 coach texts (voiceProfiles.json, verbatim): the list shows the card id as the one-word style, and the preview reads the preview text; neither applies the style. id = the companionId whose face and name the card uses; order = display order.

cards.name: Erica
cards.label: Calm, Reassuring Coach
cards.preview: During our conversations, we will slow down and create a safe, caring space. I will check in on how you feel, build trust, and help you move forward at a steady pace.

cards.name: Jasmine
cards.label: Encourages learning by doing
cards.preview: During our conversations, we will focus on learning by doing. I will share examples, clarify expectations, and support you as you try things yourself and learn from experience.

cards.name: Michael
cards.label: Build your confidence
cards.preview: During our conversations, I will help you build confidence and ownership. I will offer options, reflect your strengths, and support you in choosing and committing to your decisions.

cards.name: Sean
cards.label: Questions that bring clarity
cards.preview: During our conversations, I will ask thoughtful questions to help you think clearly. We will explore assumptions, explain your thinking, and pause to build understanding before moving forward.

cards.name: Steve
cards.label: Build on your strengths
cards.preview: During our conversations, we will focus on what you do well. I will help you use your strengths, learn from past successes, and stay motivated while facing challenges honestly.

cards.name: Evan
cards.label: Curious and explores ideas
cards.preview: During our conversations, we will explore ideas openly and creatively. I will encourage curiosity, then help you narrow choices into simple steps, so your ideas turn into action.

cards.name: Sarah
cards.label: Directive, clear, actionable
cards.preview: During our conversations, we will move fast and focus on results. I will help you clarify goals, choose next steps, and take action quickly while keeping things practical and focused.

cards.name: Emma
cards.label: Warm and understanding
cards.preview: During our conversations, we will focus on connection and feelings. I will listen closely, reflect emotions, and help you explore relationships and boundaries gently and safely.
